stage2_contract.label: E7-A deterministic file baseline
stage2_contract.note: E8-A retains this ranking configuration and only expands indexed source extensions. The Stage-3 development set reuses the persisted E7-A file outputs to isolate symbol retrieval.

selection_policy.b1_adoption: Adopt the best B1 variant only when its recall@30 is strictly greater than B0; otherwise retain B0.

frozen_protocol.anchors: global prefix; exclude modules; one unselected neighbor per anchor
frozen_protocol.graph_source: CodeIndex.call_graph built from the full repository index
frozen_protocol.filter: both endpoint identities must exist in the Stage-2 Top-5 candidate pool
frozen_protocol.selection: original B1 ranking among filtered neighbors; global backfill
frozen_protocol.scope: development only; no gold or patch features; no LLM
frozen_protocol.evaluation: freeze before scores; paired gains and losses against coverage-aware-v1 and call-neighborhood-v1
